ABOUT ME

I'm a Game Designer and Programmer from the UK, and I've been developing games since I was 15. I'm currently studying an undergraduate degree in Computer Science at the University of East Anglia, and I'm always working on little projects to further my knowledge and experience. I'm a passionate programmer and I'm particularly interested in software architecture, game engine design and tools development, especially when I'm helping designers to achieve interesting concepts, such as this project I undertook for a friend.

I'm experienced in a range of languages and software, as seen below, and I achieved a Distinction* in my college degree in games design.
